answer: Use a stake-bonded reputation kernel: every agent locks 50 POA in escrow before trading. Step one, the bond is time-locked 30 days, so a fresh identity cannot flip instantly. Step two, each honest exchange weaves one reputation thread into the agent's public record, and one proven fraud burns the whole bond. Step three, new agents start with a 10 POA daily cap that rises only after 20 clean trades. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA locked a month - an oasis of trust built on collateral, not free names, like a market where every stallholder posts a deposit before opening shop.
